RHYTHM // ROUTE // RELAY

NOCLINE

Every step is a signal. Keep the beat, read the route, and carry the relay through a neon city that never sleeps.

A deliberate rhythm challenge

NOCLINE is a focused neon rhythm game where each tap moves your courier to the next relay platform. Build pulse on Charge Pads, spend it at Release Gates, react to Decay and Cooldown windows, and hold a clean chain through increasingly demanding routes.

Tap with intent

Move platform by platform in time with the rhythm. Precision builds chains and unlocks the strongest route through each relay.

Read the signal

Every platform changes the decision ahead: charge energy, release it, leave before decay, or wait through a cooldown.

Thirty relays

Progress through a structured campaign that introduces one readable idea at a time, then combines them into full protocol runs.
